description: This is a Java test class for the ProgramValidator in the OpenMRS core project. It contains unit tests verifying validation logic for the Program entity, such as checking for null, empty, or whitespace values in fields like name, description, and concept, as well as duplicate name validation.

classes.name: ProgramValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the validation logic of ProgramValidator, extending the base context-sensitive test class from OpenMRS.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the Program's name is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfProgramNameAlreadyInUse
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the Program's name already exists in the system.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfDescriptionIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation passes if the description is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfConceptIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the Program's concept is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllRequiredFieldsHaveProperValues
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when all required fields are properly set.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationAndSaveEditedProgram
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when editing an existing program and the changes are saved successfully.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation passes if the field lengths are within acceptable limits.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the Program name exceeds maximum allowed length.
